correctness.rationale: Stationary generator gives a triangular exact moment recurrence through order three; SymPy reproduces its factored central third-moment rational expression. Descartes' rule applies because c2>c1 and c2>0 forces c3>0 on the full positive parameter domain. Constant term strictly negative and leading coefficient strictly positive prove one simple positive zero. No numerical extrapolation is used for infinite-domain uniqueness.

value.rationale: The precise qualitative number of skewness sign reversals as a control rate changes is physically interpretable and genuinely global. The theorem rules out multiple reversals for all positive trap/flip rates and all nonzero stationary telegraph bias; its outcome distinguishes position-only reset from generic orientation refreshing. This is a natural full phase classification, not a narrow arbitrary numerical invariant.
